SELECT
   $__timeGroup(I.end_time, $__interval) as [time]
  ,SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) as [${BaselineSchema}]
FROM ${BaselineSchema}.WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN ${BaselineSchema}.Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
  JOIN ${BaselineSchema}.Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(I.end_time, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
   $__timeGroup(t.adj_time, $__interval) as [time]
  ,SUM(WD.sum_duration_us) as [${BenchmarkSchema}]
FROM ${BenchmarkSchema}.WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN ${BenchmarkSchema}.Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
  JOIN (SELECT DATEADD(ms, ${BenchmarkTimeDiff} ,I.end_time) as adj_time
              ,I.end_time as end_time
        FROM ${BenchmarkSchema}.Intervals I) t ON t.end_time = I.end_time
  JOIN ${BaselineSchema}.Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(t.adj_time, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1

SELECT TOP 5
  CASE trim(A.application_name) WHEN '' THEN '-' else A.application_name END AS [Application]
  ,(SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us)*100.0)/(SELECT SUM(WD.sum_cpu_us) FROM ${BaselineSchema}.WorkloadDetails WD) AS [${BaselineSchema}]
FROM ${BaselineSchema}.WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN ${BaselineSchema}.Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  JOIN ${BaselineSchema}.Intervals I ON I.interval_id = WD.interval_id
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(I.end_time)
GROUP BY A.application_name
ORDER BY [${BaselineSchema}] DESC

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(t.adj_time, $__interval) AS [time]
  ,SUM(WD.execution_count) as [${BenchmarkSchema}]
FROM ${BenchmarkSchema}.WorkloadDetails WD
  JOIN ${BenchmarkSchema}.Intervals I ON WD.interval_id = I.interval_id
  JOIN ${BenchmarkSchema}.Applications A ON A.application_id = WD.application_id
  JOIN (SELECT DATEADD(ms, ${BenchmarkTimeDiff} ,I.end_time) as adj_time
              ,I.end_time as end_time
        FROM ${BenchmarkSchema}.Intervals I) t ON t.end_time = I.end_time
WHERE A.application_name IN (${Application:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(t.adj_time)
GROUP BY $__timeGroup(t.adj_time, $__interval)
ORDER BY 1
